name: Kansas

notes: Groceries: state tax on food phased to 0% on January 1, 2025; full local rates apply.
Liquor stores charge the 8% liquor enforcement tax instead of sales tax; beer sold by grocery and convenience stores (CMB retailers) is subject to sales tax.
Barber and beauty services: not taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.

Kansas community improvement and transportation development districts (CIDs/TDDs) add tax in small areas such as single shopping centers; they cover too little of any place to be included.
